title: ashhart/TensorFold: exact local LLM decoding behind an OpenAI-compatible API
friendlyTitle: TensorFold helps run language models faster on local hardware
summary: TensorFold serves supported language models locally through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with exact speculative decoding on Apple Silicon and support for selected NVIDIA DGX Spark configurations. The MIT-licensed project had 548 stars and active releases when checked today.
friendlySummary: TensorFold provides a local server that works with software built for the OpenAI API. It focuses on fast, exact model output on supported Apple and NVIDIA hardware.
whyItMatters: Developers can point existing OpenAI-compatible clients at a local server and experiment with faster inference while retaining deterministic output equivalence to serial decoding. Hardware and model-family support are specific, so check the project’s recipes before planning a deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test local AI without rewriting an OpenAI-compatible app. First check that your model and computer are supported.
